tool_input.description: Create date masking policy for DOB
tool_input.sql:
CREATE OR REPLACE MASKING POLICY KEVANS_WH_RIA_AI_READY.GOLD.mask_pii_date
  AS (val DATE) RETURNS DATE ->
  CASE
    WHEN IS_ROLE_IN_SESSION('RIA_FULL_ACCESS') THEN val
    WHEN IS_ROLE_IN_SESSION('ACCOUNTADMIN') THEN val
    ELSE DATE_FROM_PARTS(YEAR(val), 1, 1)
  END
